pros.sanctuary-lofts: Spacious for a 2BR. Right by the greenway! Reasonable price.
pros.4927-ewing-ave-s-3: Nice new building. Good location, albeit a bit bougie. No pet rent. Parking stall in a detached garage.
pros.4829-chicago-ave-1: Cheap! Great little community neighborhood - parkway theater, tutrle bread, very cute coffee shop, and more. Close to the parkway. On an express bus line. Cheap utilities. Large for a two bedroom. Working gas fireplace.
pros.4937-clinton-ave: GREAT location albeit not super walkable to shops - but very walkable to parks and to the parkway.
pros.5100-xerxes-ave-s: Nice size for a 2BR. Built ins are cool. Not terrible I guess?
pros.4311-abbott-ave-s-2: Definitely a good value. RIGHT next to an awesome park with tons of kid stuff. And another park. Lovely block, quiet. Downstairs neighbor Liv is delightful. Lake Harriet Lower.
pros.4804-france-ave-s-2: Unit in nicer shape than most. Nice owner downstairs. Excellent price. Backs up to a nice neighborhood, good walking roads and nature.
pros.4416-grimes-ave-s: Absolutely wonderful park a block away. Very quiet and lovely block. Great size, seemingly a good value for money.

cons.sanctuary-lofts: A little weird to be in the church? No in-unit laundry. Layout a little odd.
cons.4829-chicago-ave-1: A bit of a dump, tbh. But def a little better than s orchard st. Shared laundry in the basement. Kind of a busy street. $300 nonrefundable pet deposit. Only two bedrooms. Would need to set up an office in LR. Not much sunlight.
cons.4937-clinton-ave: Run down. Bizarre layout. Very little sunlight. Overpriced for what it is.
cons.5100-xerxes-ave-s: Second bath is in the basement. Play room down there but it's gross. Would need to have an office setup in the LR and/or main bedroom. Kinda a busy location.
cons.4311-abbott-ave-s-2: Basement is disgusting. Truly gross. Apartment is also pretty dingy. But good light! Only 2 BR, 1B. Shared thermostat. Probably gets cold.
cons.4804-france-ave-s-2: Nice owner downstairs. Small - only 2BR 1BR. On a busy street.

schoolNotes.ISLA: Feels far. Really need to take the highway to get here. Grounds seem...fine? A bit run down. But I know they recently moved to this location.
schoolNotes.Hale: Very cute. Doesn't seem too big, in a great quiet neighborhood, new play structures...obviously pretty minimal signal but it really is inviting.
schoolNotes.Concord: Quite lovely! Pretty big but well taken care of, new looking playground, nice neighborhood around. Not too bougie looking.

disqualifications.3100-w-55th-st-edina: landlord said street is too busy - not great for kids.
